summary: Owns Linux traffic-control packet and drop statistics collection.
responsibilities: Read qdisc packet and drop counters.
Aggregate traffic-control counters for node stats.

decl: func getTCStats() (packets, drops uint32, err error)
summary: Reads Linux traffic-control qdisc packet and drop counters.
summary_step: 1. Opens a rtnetlink traffic-control handle and returns a wrapped error when it cannot open.
2. Reads qdisc state and returns a wrapped error when qdisc lookup fails.
3. Aggregates packet and drop counters across all qdiscs and returns them.
